gloss: as much as possible; to the extent possible

definitions.gloss: as much as possible; to the greatest extent possible
definitions.explanation: An adverbial expression meaning to do something to the fullest extent one can. More formal than できるだけ.

examples.japanese: {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り{早|はや}く{返事|へんじ}します。
examples.english: I will reply as soon as possible.

examples.japanese: {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}に{参加|さんか}してほしい。
examples.english: I want as many people as possible to participate.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}への{影響|えいきょう}を{可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り{小|ちい}さくするべきだ。
examples.english: We should minimize the environmental impact as much as possible.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal adverbial phrase used in both written and spoken Japanese. More polished than できるだけ, which has the same meaning but is more casual. Often used in business, official communications, and polite requests.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り{早|はや}く (as soon as possible)
- {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り{多|おお}く (as much as possible)
- {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り{努力|どりょく}する (to make every possible effort)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- できるだけ: as much as possible — more casual and commonly used in everyday speech
- なるべく: as much as possible, preferably — similar level of casualness to できるだけ
